Supply and Delivery#000.src: What? Don't look at me like that! We had a perfectly fair interaction which we both benefited from. I got the plant, and you... well. You gained experience?

Supply and Delivery#001.src: So either you run the supplies to {p}... or we both run away and start new lives, and we avoid the consequences of our actions!

Supply and Delivery#002.src: Howdy! Lookin' to hitch a ride off to {p}? Sorry to say, but the wagon's broken down.

Supply and Delivery#003.src: I reckon it won't be long 'till it's fixed up, but you'll have to make the journey yourself for now.

Supply and Delivery#004.src: This fast travel requires Supply and Delivery to use.

Supply and Delivery#005.src: I hope these emeralds will suffice. Additionally... we have recently fixed up one of our broken carts, which makes the trip to {p} and back.

Supply and Delivery#007.src: Oh, man... What am I going to do now...
Supply and Delivery#007.dst: 噢，天哪……我现在该怎么办……
Supply and Delivery#007.speaker: Ope

Supply and Delivery#008.src: O-oh! H-hello soldier! Wow, what a coincidence that we're both here... in {p}... today...
Supply and Delivery#008.dst: 噢、噢！你、你好，士兵！哇，真巧，我们今天……都在……{p}……
Supply and Delivery#008.speaker: Ope

Supply and Delivery#009.src: What? Don't look at me like that! We had a perfectly fair interaction which we both benefitted from. I got the plant, and you... well. You gained experience?
Supply and Delivery#009.dst: 什么？别那样看我！我们那是一次完全公平、双方都有好处的交流。我拿到了植物，而你……嗯。你获得了经验？
Supply and Delivery#009.speaker: Ope

Supply and Delivery#010.src: Look, alright, I get it! But I can't pay you back either way. The mayor sent me here to pick up a crate of supplies for the village.
Supply and Delivery#010.dst: 好啦，好啦，我懂了！但反正我也还不了你钱。镇长派我来这里给村子领一箱补给。
Supply and Delivery#010.speaker: Ope

Supply and Delivery#011.src: The issue is... I've already run out of money on- uh, unrelated purchases. And even if I had the money, I couldn't buy the supply crate anyway...
Supply and Delivery#011.dst: 问题是……我的钱已经花在——呃，一些不相干的东西上了。而且就算我有钱，我也买不了那箱补给……
Supply and Delivery#011.speaker: Ope

Supply and Delivery#012.src: Those two over there who run the market banned me from ever using it after I tried to buy out the world's supplies of magical powders.
Supply and Delivery#012.dst: 那边管市场的那两个人，在我试图买光全世界的魔法粉末之后，就永久禁止我使用市场了。
Supply and Delivery#012.speaker: Ope

Supply and Delivery#013.src: Look, it's not my fault I'm making big market moves. I'm just, you know- smarter than all these other folks!
Supply and Delivery#013.dst: 听着，我在市场上大展拳脚又不是我的错。我只是，你知道的——比其他人都聪明而已！
Supply and Delivery#013.speaker: Ope

Supply and Delivery#014.src: ... The point is. I could really use your help right now! I- I promise, I'll pay you back for it this time.
Supply and Delivery#014.dst: ……重点是。我现在真的很需要你帮忙！我——我保证，这次我一定会还你。
Supply and Delivery#014.speaker: Ope

Supply and Delivery#015.src: All you need to do is go over to the Trade Market, and buy the supply crate for me. Please?
Supply and Delivery#015.dst: 你只要去交易市场，帮我买那箱补给就行。拜托？
Supply and Delivery#015.speaker: Ope

Supply and Delivery#024.src: Well, do you have any other friends we could get involved? There was... that other soldier guy, right? His name was... Tim. Or something.
Supply and Delivery#024.dst: 嗯，你还有别的朋友能拉进来帮忙吗？好像有……另一个士兵，对吧？他叫……Tim。还是什么的。
Supply and Delivery#024.speaker: Ope

Supply and Delivery#025.src: Look- alright, I get it, I'm a jerk who doesn't remember peoples' names! Could you just ask him to buy the supplies for us?? He's our last hope... probably.
Supply and Delivery#025.dst: 好啦——好啦，我懂了，我就是个记不住别人名字的混蛋！你就不能请他帮我们买补给吗？？他是我们最后的希望了……大概吧。
Supply and Delivery#025.speaker: Ope

Supply and Delivery#026.src: Purchase the supply crate from the Trade Market at [{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Supply and Delivery#026.dst: 在 [{~}, {~}, -{~}] 的交易市场购买补给箱。

Supply and Delivery#027.src: Hey, good work! Now you'll need to pick up the supply crate.
Supply and Delivery#027.dst: 嘿，干得好！现在你得去领取补给箱。
Supply and Delivery#027.speaker: Ope

Supply and Delivery#028.src: Find Tasim at [{~}, {~}, -{~}] and convince him to buy the supply crate for you.
Supply and Delivery#028.dst: 找到 [{~}, {~}, -{~}] 的 Tasim，说服他帮你买补给箱。

Supply and Delivery#029.src: Oh, hey {u}! Are you just here to hang out? Or- that look on your face tells me you're here for something else.
Supply and Delivery#029.dst: 噢，嘿 {u}！你只是来这里闲晃的吗？还是——看你的表情，是有别的事吧。
Supply and Delivery#029.speaker: Tasim

Supply and Delivery#030.src: [{~}] Can you buy something from the Trade Market for me?
Supply and Delivery#030.dst: [{~}] 你能帮我在交易市场买样东西吗？

Supply and Delivery#031.src: I... guess so? Is there a reason you can't do it yourself?
Supply and Delivery#031.dst: 我……应该可以吧？你有什么原因不能自己买吗？
Supply and Delivery#031.speaker: Tasim

Supply and Delivery#032.src: ...You're banned from the market? How did you even manage that? We haven't even been in {p} for that long!
Supply and Delivery#032.dst: ……你被禁止使用市场了？你到底是怎么做到的？我们来 {p} 也没多久啊！
Supply and Delivery#032.speaker: Tasim

Supply and Delivery#033.src: You- what!? Nevermind, I don't actually want to know. Come on, lead the way. I'll buy... whatever it is you need.
Supply and Delivery#033.dst: 你——什么！？算了，我其实不想知道。来吧，带路。我帮你买……不管你要的是什么。
Supply and Delivery#033.speaker: Tasim

Supply and Delivery#034.src: ...Oh. Well, that explains that. Though- is there a reason you can't get it yourself?
Supply and Delivery#034.dst: ……噢。好吧，这就说得通了。不过——你有什么原因不能自己去买吗？
Supply and Delivery#034.speaker: Tasim

Supply and Delivery#035.src: ...You're banned from the market? How did you even manage that? We haven't even been in {p} for that long!

Supply and Delivery#044.src: Bring Tasim to the Trade Market at [{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Supply and Delivery#044.dst: 带 Tasim 去 [{~}, {~}, -{~}] 的交易市场。

Supply and Delivery#045.src: Alright. So I'm just buying a supply crate...
Supply and Delivery#045.dst: 好。所以我只是要买一个补给箱……
Supply and Delivery#045.speaker: Tasim

Supply and Delivery#046.src: Here it is. I wish you luck with... whatever it is you're up to.
Supply and Delivery#046.dst: 给你。祝你……不管在忙什么都顺利。
Supply and Delivery#046.speaker: Tasim

Supply and Delivery#047.src: Return to Ope with the supply crate at [{~}, {~}, -{~}]
Supply and Delivery#047.dst: 带着补给箱回到 [{~}, {~}, -{~}] 的 Ope 那里

Supply and Delivery#048.src: Perfect! Now, quickly, come back over here, before those two realize you're working with me!
Supply and Delivery#048.dst: 太好了！现在，快回到这边来，趁那两个人还没发现你是跟我一伙的！
Supply and Delivery#048.speaker: Ope

Supply and Delivery#049.src: You got the item? Good. Good, good good.
Supply and Delivery#049.dst: 你拿到东西了？很好。很好，很好很好。
Supply and Delivery#049.speaker: Ope

Supply and Delivery#050.src: Okay! Now, we're onto step two. So, you see, this package still needs to make it to {p}...
Supply and Delivery#050.dst: 好！现在，我们进入第二步。你看，这个包裹还得送到 {p}……
Supply and Delivery#050.speaker: Ope

Supply and Delivery#051.src: And. Well. You're the one holding the crate, not me! So... you know!
Supply and Delivery#051.dst: 而且。嗯。拿着箱子的是你，不是我！所以……你懂的！
Supply and Delivery#051.speaker: Ope

Supply and Delivery#052.src: Great! You know the way by now, surely! No need for me to, uh, get in your way!
Supply and Delivery#052.dst: 太好了！你现在肯定认得路了！就不用我，呃，碍你的事了！
Supply and Delivery#052.speaker: Ope

Supply and Delivery#053.src: Just take those supplies to {p}, and. Well. Things will work out.
Supply and Delivery#053.dst: 你只要把补给送到 {p}，然后。嗯。事情就会解决了。
Supply and Delivery#053.speaker: Ope

Supply and Delivery#055.src: Well, you see. I really don't want to do it. And I'm not going to!
Supply and Delivery#055.dst: 嗯，你看。我真的不想做这件事。而且我不打算做！
Supply and Delivery#055.speaker: Ope

Supply and Delivery#056.src: So you either run the supplies to {p}... or we both run away and start new lives, and we avoid the consequences of our actions!
Supply and Delivery#056.dst: 所以要么你把补给送到 {p}……要么我们俩一起跑路重新开始人生，逃避我们行为的后果！
Supply and Delivery#056.speaker: Ope

Supply and Delivery#057.src: ...no? No. Okay. Worth a shot. Well, you know the way by now! No need for me to, uh, get in your way! Heh...
Supply and Delivery#057.dst: ……不要？不要。好吧。试试也值得。嗯，你现在认得路了！就不用我，呃，碍你的事了！嘿嘿……
Supply and Delivery#057.speaker: Ope

Supply and Delivery#058.src: He bought you the item? Good. Good, good good. Okay! That was... harder than expected.
Supply and Delivery#058.dst: 他帮你买到了？很好。很好，很好很好。好！那……比预想的难。
Supply and Delivery#058.speaker: Ope

Supply and Delivery#059.speaker: Ope

Supply and Delivery#060.speaker: Ope

Supply and Delivery#066.speaker: Ope

Supply and Delivery#067.src: Bring the supply crate to Mayor Alvin in {p} at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Supply and Delivery#067.dst: 把补给箱带给 {p} [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] 的 Alvin 镇长。

Supply and Delivery#068.src: Ah, hello! What can I do for you today?
Supply and Delivery#068.dst: 啊，你好！今天有什么能为你效劳的？
Supply and Delivery#068.speaker: Mayor Alvin

Supply and Delivery#069.src: Ah... So you do. I thought I had sent Ope to pick that up...
Supply and Delivery#069.dst: 啊……原来是你带来了。我还以为我是派 Ope 去领的……
Supply and Delivery#069.speaker: Mayor Alvin

Supply and Delivery#070.src: More of his shenanigans, I suppose. I am sorry you have had to deal with him twice.
Supply and Delivery#070.dst: 我想又是他在胡闹吧。很抱歉你得跟他打两次交道。
Supply and Delivery#070.speaker: Mayor Alvin

Supply and Delivery#071.src: When he returns to the village, I'm going to need to have a word with him... Ah, but of course, I should pay you for your troubles.
Supply and Delivery#071.dst: 等他回村子，我得跟他好好谈谈……啊，不过当然，我该付你辛苦费。
Supply and Delivery#071.speaker: Mayor Alvin

Supply and Delivery#072.src: I hope these emeralds will suffice. Additionally... we recently fixed up one of our broken carts, which makes the trip to {p} and back.
Supply and Delivery#072.dst: 希望这些绿宝石够了。另外……我们最近修好了一辆坏掉的马车，它可以往返 {p}。
Supply and Delivery#072.speaker: Mayor Alvin

Supply and Delivery#073.src: You may feel free to use it whenever you like! As thanks for all you have done for us.
Supply and Delivery#073.dst: 你随时都可以使用！作为你为我们所做的一切的谢礼。
Supply and Delivery#073.speaker: Mayor Alvin

Supply and Delivery#074.src: He's... difficult. He's the son of my sister, who was unfortunately killed by spiders some time ago.
Supply and Delivery#074.dst: 他……很难搞。他是我姐姐的儿子，我姐姐前些年不幸被蜘蛛杀死了。
Supply and Delivery#074.speaker: Mayor Alvin

Supply and Delivery#075.src: With his father out of the picture, I had to take him in. He's a grown man now, yes, but... I fear the loss has taken a toll on us both.
Supply and Delivery#075.dst: 他父亲又不在身边，我只好收养他。是的，他现在已经是个大人了，但是……我担心这份失去对我们俩都造成了影响。
Supply and Delivery#075.speaker: Mayor Alvin

Supply and Delivery#076.src: I truly hope he will cease with these ridiculous ploys sometime soon... but I can't bring myself to do more than give him a stern talking to.
Supply and Delivery#076.dst: 我真心希望他能早点停止这些荒唐的把戏……但我除了严厉训他一顿，也狠不下心做更多。
Supply and Delivery#076.speaker: Mayor Alvin

Supply and Delivery#077.src: He's a good man, truly. I believe that with my whole heart. It's alright if you don't feel the same way, though. I will not force you to interact with him if you do not wish to.
Supply and Delivery#077.dst: 他是个好人，真的。我全心全意这么相信。不过你不这么想也没关系。如果你不愿意，我不会强迫你跟他打交道。
Supply and Delivery#077.speaker: Mayor Alvin

Supply and Delivery#078.src: Oh, dear... I suppose it must have been fifteen years ago that I took the position, when the old mayor stepped down.
Supply and Delivery#078.dst: 噢，天哪……我想大概是十五年前，老镇长退下来的时候，我接下了这个职位。
Supply and Delivery#078.speaker: Mayor Alvin

Supply and Delivery#079.src: He was a kind man, always looking out for the townsfolk. Though, by the time he retired, it was clear he was growing restless in our little town.
Supply and Delivery#079.dst: 他是个善良的人，总是照顾着镇民。不过等他退休的时候，很明显他在我们这个小镇里已经待不住了。
Supply and Delivery#079.speaker: Mayor Alvin

Supply and Delivery#080.src: Well, as soon as he passed down the position to me, he immediately traveled to {p} and enlisted in their army! I hear he's in the business of training soldiers these days.
Supply and Delivery#080.dst: 结果，他一把职位交给我，就马上去了 {p}，加入了那里的军队！听说他现在在训练士兵。
Supply and Delivery#080.speaker: Mayor Alvin

Supply and Delivery#081.src: Ah, but I've tried lived up to his legacy. I like to think I've done well in my time as mayor!
Supply and Delivery#081.dst: 啊，不过我一直努力不辜负他留下的传统。我觉得我当镇长这些年做得还不错！
Supply and Delivery#081.speaker: Mayor Alvin

Supply and Delivery#082.src: A fine day for passing through! I hope you enjoy your stay.
Supply and Delivery#082.dst: 真是个适合路过的好日子！希望你在这里过得愉快。
Supply and Delivery#082.speaker: Mayor Alvin
